verdict: Solid 28-day ROAS, but purchases softened sharply in the last week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 35 purchases on $1,503 in spend, returning $3.74 for every $1 spent — a healthy baseline. In the most recent 7 days, however, purchases fell 33% and return on ad spend dropped 11% versus the prior 7-day window; Instagram reach has also trended down roughly 21% week-over-week while daily spend held flat, pointing to creative fatigue as the likely driver rather than a budget issue. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to address the declining reach and protect purchase volume. Your Google Business Profile also went dark for three days (Sep 30–Oct 2) on what appears to be a listing feed issue, not a drop in demand — that is being investigated and corrected now. Next period, expect stabilized reach as new creative rotates in, and the subscribe page and CRM flows — currently being completed — will close gaps that are limiting funnel visibility.
